The present case has been listed today as it is an old/ targeted matter.

2. The present appeal has been filed by the Appellants against the Judgment on conviction dated 26.07.2004 and order on sentence dated 30.07.2004 in FIR No.220/2002, registered at Police Station Uttam Nagar for the offence punishable under Sections 498A/304B/34 of the Indian Penal Code.

The appeal was admitted on 28.09.2004 and vide orders dated 15.12.2004 and 15.04.2005,
the sentence of the Appellant nos.2 and 3 suspended respectively and vide judgment dated 01.11.2007, the sentence of Appellant no.1 was suspended during the pendency of the Appeal.
3.
Today, there is no appearance on behalf of the Appellants.
4. Let Court Notice be issued to the Appellants, learned Counsel for the Appellants as well as to the Sureties, informing them about the next date of hearing.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 08/08/2025 at 23:33:15 5.
Let an e-copy of the paper book be supplied to the parties.

6. List on 18.09.2025.
